text: The Goa Homeopathy Council Act, 2001 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 200163 Act Number: 63 Enactment Date: 2001-07-23 Act Year: 2001 Short Title: The Goa Homeopathy Council Act, 2001 Long Title: To provide for the constitution of the Goa State Council of Indian system of medicines and homeopathy, registration of practitioners in said medicines, maintenance of Register of practitioners, the practice/qualifications of such medicines and with a view to encourage the study, spread of such system of medicine and to make certain other provisions relating to the practitioners generally in the State of Goa.
